_comment: pcfg_rules.json — Module 2-K PCFG Domain-Derived Dictionary Generator
_description: Rules for generating candidate passwords from target domain components. Applied by PcfgDictGenerator. Token substitution is applied to the domain base (e.g., 'acme' from 'acme.corp.local') before suffixes/prefixes are appended.

year_range._comment: Numeric year suffixes appended to base tokens. Current year ± 3.

numeric_suffixes._comment: Common numeric strings appended after the base token or year.

special_suffixes._comment: Special character suffixes appended to base+year combinations.

common_suffixes._comment: Word suffixes commonly appended in enterprise password policies.

case_transforms._comment: Case transformations applied to the raw domain base token.

leet_substitutions._comment: Single-character leet-speak substitutions. Applied selectively (not exhaustively) to avoid combinatorial explosion. Only the first matching character in the token is substituted per rule.

leet_apply_strategy._comment: Controls how many leet substitutions are applied per candidate. 'single' applies one substitution at a time (avoids combinatorial explosion). 'all' applies all substitutions simultaneously.

separator_chars._comment: Characters inserted between token components (base + year, prefix + base, etc.).

domain_component_extraction._comment: Rules for splitting a FQDN into candidate base tokens. Example: 'mail.acme-corp.co.uk' → ['mail', 'acme', 'corp', 'acmecorp']. TLDs and very short tokens (len < 3) are discarded.

max_candidates._comment: Hard cap on total candidates returned by PcfgDictGenerator.generate(). Prevents runaway generation on complex domains.

dedup._comment: Whether to deduplicate the final candidate list before returning.
